name: The Red Ledger
source:
Rain falls on a ruined house. Someone has left a white rose behind, and a name that the city would rather forget has begun to surface again.

The Rose Ledger is a slow-burn noir about debts that are never written down, and the people who collect them. Episode 1 opens the account. What begins as a single unanswered question leads into a world of quiet favours, careful lies, and the kind of attraction that is hard to trust.

[From [url=https://www.patreon.com/cw/InfinitySaga]Patreon[/url]]
